final: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 THEN sc.gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 THEN sc.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), av AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb FROM per) SELECT per.status, per.total_scans, per.gb_per_min, per.gb_per_min - av.avg_gb AS exceeds_avg FROM per, av WHERE per.gb_per_min > av.avg_gb
